# Extract the relevant columns
doubles = df['number_of_doubles']
salary = df['salary_in_thousands_of_dollars']

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values in doubles:", doubles.isna().sum())
print("Missing values in salary:", salary.isna().sum())

# Remove any rows with missing values in either column
valid_data = df[['number_of_doubles', 'salary_in_thousands_of_dollars']].dropna()
print(f"\nNumber of valid records for analysis: {len(valid_data)}")

doubles_clean = valid_data['number_of_doubles']
salary_clean = valid_data['salary_in_thousands_of_dollars']

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient and p-value
correlation_coefficient, p_value = stats.pearsonr(doubles_clean, salary_clean)

print(f"\nPearson Correlation Coefficient (r): {correlation_coefficient}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

# Check significance at alpha = 0.05
alpha = 0.05
is_significant = p_value < alpha
print(f"\nIs the correlation significant (p < 0.05)? {is_significant}")

# Round to required precision
r_rounded = round(correlation_coefficient, 2)
p_rounded = round(p_value, 4)

print(f"\nRounded correlation coefficient: {r_rounded}")
print(f"Rounded p-value: {p_rounded}")

# Format the answer as required
answer = f"@correlation_coefficient[{r_rounded}] @p_value[{p_rounded}]"
print(f"\nFormatted answer: {answer}")
